H4 — demo _kit symlink not committed. Only matters if _internal/demo-page/ is ever promoted to public examples.

blocks.title: Tooltip behavior to test
blocks.content: Hover a term — tooltip appears after 120ms. Move the mouse toward the tooltip — it stays visible (bridge-hover). Select text inside — it works because the tooltip is a real DOM node. Click the term — pinned (accent ring). Click again or click another term — unpinned.

content.content: A single global controller manages one active tooltip. Mouseenter triggers a 120ms show delay; mouseleave triggers a 300ms hide. If the mouse enters the tooltip during the hide window, the timer cancels. Click toggles pinned state (visible accent ring). Touch devices (matchMedia '(hover: none)') get click-only behavior. Esc closes pinned. Click anywhere outside .gloss or .tooltip-popup closes pinned.

blocks.title: What's next
blocks.lead: Prioritized from the round-5 review. Marked with effort sketch.

steps.title: H3 — Recursive HTML build + directory structure preservation
steps.meta: files: bin/html-doc · risk: medium · effort: ~1 round
steps.content: find_html_files uses .glob (root-only) while find_json_pages uses .rglob (recursive). Subfolder pages appear in site-manifest.json but never build. Also flatten-collision in build_site. Need to change discovery, preserve relative paths in output, and verify with a nested example.

steps.title: S2 proper — Inline glossary data in standalone builds
steps.meta: files: bin/html-doc, chrome.js · risk: medium · effort: ~1 round
steps.content: Build_standalone embeds active domain glossary + extref files as JSON script tags with well-known IDs. chrome.js's kit loader checks for these in standalone mode before falling back to fetch. Restores tooltips offline.

steps.title: Schema validation at build time
steps.meta: files: bin/html-doc · new dep: jsonschema · effort: ~½ day
steps.content: Run page.schema.json against each page during build. Catch malformed JSON / unknown kinds / missing required fields before runtime. Today the build silently skips JSON-decode failures.

steps.title: M2 — Document data-def trust boundary
steps.content: Code comment at tooltip controller's build() function stating that data-def accepts HTML only from kit-controlled sources.

steps.title: Polish — cycleTheme event, isTouch live, page-toc double-build, Mermaid SRI
steps.content: L3 + open-question items. Dispatch CustomEvent on theme change instead of monkey-patching cycleTheme. Re-evaluate isTouch via matchMedia listener. Remove rAF in PageToc.connectedCallback. Add integrity hash to Mermaid CDN script.

blocks.title: Then — v2.0.0 tag
blocks.content: After 1 + 2 land we're past the items the review flagged as 'realistic-use breakage'. The remainder is polish and documentation. Cut v2.0.0 then.
